name: World Bank
label: World Bank
description: World Bank official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: indicator_get, country_list, catalog_search. Docs: https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/889392-about-the-indicators-api-documentation. World Bank Indicators API v2. No key. Attribution to World Bank. Dataset licences still apply. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One World Bank request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"indicator_get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: indicator_get | country_list | catalog_search. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'indicator_get'.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `country` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: incomeLevel
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `incomeLevel` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: indicator
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `indicator` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: mrv
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `mrv` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `page` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `per_page` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: region
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `region` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: source
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `source` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: indicator_get, country_list, catalog_search.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
